title: a11y focus-steal user-active silent yield: mechanism ref
desc: T3 reference for a11y-focus-steal-user-active-silent-yield. Exact retry/idle-threshold mechanics inside RestoreFocusWithRetryAsync.
steps: RETRY MECHANICS: Sentinel retries ForceForegroundWindow up to 5s (150ms x 33 attempts)
IDLE CHECK: inside the loop, checks NativeMethods.GetUserIdleMs() on every attempt
BAIL CONDITION: if idle < 1500ms (user is typing/clicking), sets userBailed=true and breaks immediately -- no IME restore, no cursor restore, no bug report

RATIONALE: on userBailed the user foreground choice wins; only true involuntary steals (idle >= 1500ms) get reported. This threshold (1500ms) is shared with the FocusStealSentinel DetectAndRecover path in ReadinessBridges.FocusStealSentinel.cs.
author: claude
